name: FIX MY PINGGGGG
summary: Makes sure that as long as you have internet, you will be able to both PING and CONNECT to the server.

name: Toggle Sprint
summary: Allows you to keep sprinting when sprint is toggled.

name: Account Switcher
summary: This mod makes it so that you can switch account without closing minecraft!

name: Auto Fast XP
summary: Automatically throws XP bottles rapidly when you hold right-click. Perfect for quickly gaining XP!

name: Allow Offline Lan Join
summary: Fixes a bug where offline players are not able to join someone's lan world in same network

name: /Tpa Teleport
summary: Allows you to /tpa request other players, /tpa here other players, accept and deny requests.

name: fpsdisplaymod
summary:
A colorful display of your current fps
red = bad, yellow = ok, green = playable, purple = fantastic

name: Optimized Vein Miner
summary: Hate digging out each ore block one by one? This mod makes it so that you can mine whole veins instantly.

name: I DONT WANT PARTICLES!!!
summary: Hate the lag when particles clog your screen? This mod kills every particle effect, so you get buttery‑smooth FPS without any visual noise.

name: Working Full Bright
summary: A full bright mod that just works.

name: Set Home Anywhere
summary: Allows you to set home in singleplayer! As well as for servers.

name: Optimized Day Counter
summary: Want to know what day it is and what hour it is in your minecraft world? Well this mod does exactly that.

name: Allow Disconnect
summary: Adds a disconnect button to server loading screens so when u r stuck on a loading screen you can use the button to disconnect from the server

name: Sort Chest
summary: This mod allows you to organize and stack your items automatically in chests, grouping same item types into stacks when they were scattered around

name: Stackable Totems (up to 64)
summary: Allows you to stack totems up to 64

name: Keep Inventory
summary: Enforces keepInventory gamerule to always be true. Never lose your items on death!

name: No Hostile Mobs
summary: Want no hostile mobs but hate peaceful mode? This mod makes it so that no hostile mobs can spawn no matter the difficulty, meaning you could have difficulty set to hard while no hostile mobs spawn.

name: Craftable Slime Balls
summary: allows you to craft 9 slime balls with 8 sugarcane + water bucket

name: Common Server Core
summary: /tpa, /home, /rtp, random spawn all included in one mod. Compatible for single player worlds!

name: Snow Accumulation
summary: Tired of only 1 layer of snow? This mod fixes that, allowing snow to accumulate to world height (configurable)

name: Reset Villager Trades
summary: Reset a villager trade if it sells items you don't want, makes getting good librarians much easier for 1.12.2

name: Lifesteal Mod
summary: lose a heart on death, gain a heart by killing a player. Hit 0 hearts and you're permanently banned.

name: Seed Protect
summary: Prevents farmland trampling so your planted crops stay safe from mobs and players.

name: ModConfigEditor
summary: Edit mod configs from minecraft directly, better gui, more efficient

name: Nature Is Alive
summary: A mod that makes nature feel alive. Blocks will decay over time, moss will grow if water source nearby, grass will grow and spread, forests will spread, and more.

name: Instant Auto Totem
summary: Hate dying because you forget to keep a Totem of Undying in your offhand? This mod fixes that.

name: AntiWeakChat
summary: Tired of vip players having weird chat colors, or a spammer that you can't ignore? Or you just want some private chat with friend and highlight their messages? Well this mod does all of that.

name: Auto Login & Auto Register
summary: Forgot your password again? Have to think of a password for /register again? Well this mod fixes that, adding auto register, and auto login!

name: Elytra Chestplate Swap
summary: Backports the feature from modern minecraft where you can easily swap elytra with chestplate back to 1.12.2

name: Train - Furnance Minecart
summary: makes furnance minecarts useful again so you dont need to use powered rails

name: Mosslize
summary: Makes it so that stone, cobblestone, stone bricks near water will turn into its mossy form as time passes

name: Play Multiplayer in Single Player
summary: A utility mod that makes singleplayer worlds behave more like lightweight multiplayer sessions by letting you switch identities before entering a world or before joining a server.

name: Smooth Container
summary: Eliminates container open lag by instantly rendering GUIs.

name: Keep Equipment
summary: Hate losing your gear when you die? This mod is essentially a keep inventory mod, but you can configure what you can loose or not loose.

name: Factorized Ores
summary: Tired of looking for ores in mines? well this mod adds a block that you can factorize to generate infinite minerals

name: TNT Duper
summary: Why look for TNT dupers when you could just build one with one dispenser and one tnt?

name: World Instant Leaf Decay
summary: Hate waiting for leaves to slowly disappear after cutting a tree? Hate the lag from other leaf decay mods? This mod makes it so that leaves instantly disappear, no particles, no scattered drops, the drops all focus to one point.

name: Quick Stack
summary: Hate manually moving items from your inventory to chests? This mod makes it so that you can transfer items into nearby containers with a single press.

name: Always Rain
summary: Sometimes rain makes minecraft feel more sad but peaceful, this mod makes it always rain so you could always have this feeling.

name: Instant Experience Orb
summary: Instantly absorb XP orbs, clump them together to reduce lag, and use simplified 1 orb = 1 level system!

name: Entity 0 Elytra Fix
summary: This fixes a 1.12.2 issue where when your player entity id is 0 you can't use fireworks to boost your elytra

name: Load My World PROPERLY
summary: Sometimes in old versions of minecraft like 1.12.2 you can get stuck after minecraft loads your world and terrain, this mod tries its best to force you into the world and prevents you from being stuck.

name: Dont Break crops that are not grown yet
summary: Prevents accidental breaks on unripe crops, so you dont have to worry again breaking weets that are not fully grown. Sneak to still remove misplaced seeds.

name: Crop Growth Accelerator
summary: This mod makes them grow faster when you're nearby or sleeping or during rain and thunder storms, it also hinders crop growth when its snowing.

name: Instant Bridge
summary: Hate bridging manually? Sneak and walk forward to build automatically now (Configurable Key Bind)

name: Optimized Mining
summary: I always hated strip mining, there are some good mods that make your pickaxe break more blocks, but its either not for 1.12.2 or doesn't work, so here's a mod that works.

name: Longer Day
summary: Allows you to configure how long a day and night lasts in minecraft, this mod by default sets its to 1 hour for day and 1 hour for night instead of the original 10 minute day and night.

name: Throw Full Stack
summary: Allows you to hover on a item and press shift and press q once on the item to throw the entire stack out of your inventory

name: Instant-Hoppers
summary: Hate that hoppers move items one by one? Well this mod makes hoppers move full stacks in one go.

name: Old Notch Apples
summary: Craft Enchanted Golden Apples with 8 gold blocks + 1 apple. Restores 1.8.9 effects: Regen V, Absorption IV, Resistance I, Fire Resistance I.

name: World Auto Eat
summary: Hate having to stop mining to eat? This mod makes it so that you automatically eat when you're hungry without the animation nor the slow down nor taking up your hotbar or even breaking your action.

name: Proper Toggle Sneak Sprint
summary: Hate holding sprint and sneak keys? Hate double‑tap sprint? This mod makes it so you can toggle them with one press!

name: World Auto Replant
summary: Hate manually replanting crops after you harvest them? This mod does it for you automatically.

name: All Mobs Hate The SUN
summary: Hate when hostile mobs don't burn in daylight? Well this mod makes it so that ALL hostile mobs burn in the sun.

name: World Auto Feeder
summary: Hate manually feeding animals to breed them? This mod automatically feeds them from nearby chests, so you can breed them without lifting a finger.

name: World Auto Tool Swap
summary: Hate having to switch tools while mining? This mod makes it so that you just keep mining with the right tool.

name: World Mob Vision
summary: Have you ever felt ignored by the hostile mobs in your world? Well this mod makes it so that every hostile mob when they spawn they know EXACTLY where you are, and will try to find their way to you.

name: World Auto Torch Placer
summary: Hate stopping to place torches while mining? This mod automatically drops a torch whenever it gets dark, so you can keep digging without breaking your flow.

name: Infinite Water Bucket
summary: This mod makes it so that you can place water source blocks infinitely as long as you have 1 water bucket.
